'''Äslajä''' was a location<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> on the planet<ref name="SotES">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> that hosted the [[Palawa Band]] [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] tournament in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|sports/1359_1.html|Jedi Defeated for Teräs Käsi Title}} is set on the date 13:5:9, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Äslajä was first mentioned in the [[in-universe]] news story "Jedi Defeated for Teräs Käsi Title," which was published in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #47'']],<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|sports/1359_1.html|Jedi Defeated for Teräs Käsi Title}}</ref> a [[March 14]], [[2002]]<ref name="HNN47 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6774617|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-05-09|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-14}}</ref> issue of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]].<ref name="HNN" /> The issue was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> The [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' spelled the location as "Aslaja".<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" />
